text:
maria: Heads-up — a user reported our npm package 0.12.3 fails in edge runtimes. Import error from Vercel serverless: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`

aditya: Can you paste the exact error + package.json?

maria: Error snippet:```
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package "@redwood/inference-sdk" imported from /vercel/path/to/.vercel_build_output/functions/api/index.func/.next/server/pages/api/handler.mjs
    at new NodeError (node:internal/errors:372:5)
    at finalizeResolution (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:429:11)
    at moduleResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:1001:10)
    at defaultResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:1219:11)
    at ESMLoader.resolve (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:323:30)
    at ESMLoader.getModuleJob (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:263:18)
```

sophie: Ugh, this is usually a bad exports map or wrong file extensions from the build. I saw a publish job put `index.cjs.mjs` in dist once.

aditya: Can you paste package.json from the published tarball?

maria: From the tarball manifest:```
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference-sdk",
  "version": "0.12.3",
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "dist/index.cjs",
      "import": "dist/index.cjs.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "sourceMap": false
}
```

maria: See the `import` path points to `dist/index.cjs.mjs` (double-extension). Looks like our rollup/tsc plugin misconfigured when emitting mjs variant.

aditya: That explains the edge runtime (which uses ESM) — it's trying to import the `import` entry and can't find it. Node's resolver doesn't accept double-ext.

sophie: And source maps are disabled in publish, so devs have a hard time tracing. Also `types` file missing in the tarball for some releases — got a report earlier.

maria: Reproduction steps I used: 1) create fresh Next app 2) `npm i @redwood/inference-sdk@0.12.3` 3) import with `import {Client} from '@redwood/inference-sdk'` 4) build on vercel

aditya: Quick patch idea: republish 0.12.4 that fixes exports to:```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

sophie: Also add a CI check to validate that all files referenced in package.json actually exist in the tarball. We should fail the release job if any `exports` target is missing or contains unexpected `.` characters (some of our internal transforms append extensions accidentally).

maria: Agreed. I'll open a patch PR for the rollup config and a follow-up PR for the publish sanity check.

aditya: For the immediate customer impact, we can publish a scoped `0.12.4` with the corrected exports + include sourcemaps and types. I'll handle the publish if you push the built artifact to the release branch.

sophie: Add an npm deprecation message on 0.12.3 and link to changelog. Also add a small note in release docs to run `npm pack` locally and inspect tarball contents before publishing.

build-bot: CI pipeline detected missing files for 0.12.3 release: missing ["dist/index.mjs", "dist/index.cjs.mjs.map", "dist/index.d.ts"] — blocking redeploy. :warning:

aditya: Thanks build-bot — I'll create the patched build and push tags. Can someone assign the PR to me? @sophie

sophie: Assigned. Also creating a small grep-based test in our release action: verify every path in package.json.exports exists in `npm pack` tarball. If mismatch -> fail.

maria: Customer updated: we have a quick workaround — they can `import {Client} from '@redwood/inference-sdk/dist/index.mjs'` manually for now. Not ideal but buys time.

aditya: Cool. I'll push fix today and kick off a canary publish for Dedicated/internal users first.

sophie: Note for postmortem: add entry "publish: double extension in exports" and link to the PR + CI test.

maria: Thanks team. Closing loop soon. :thumbsup:
